questions.text: Is this post (including any text in attached images) about United States politics, economics, or culture war, written as if the author lives in the US? Examples: Democrats or Republicans, US politicians, the minimum wage or prices in dollars, rent or wages in US cities, US healthcare or insurance, taxes, student loans, guns, immigration, or 'in this country' complaints about America. Answer no for posts that are not about the US, and for neutral news reports.

Is this post (including any text in attached images) a sweeping, low-effort take designed to farm replies on a divisive theme, such as capitalism vs socialism, billionaires or the rich, the working class, or rejecting modern technology ("nobody wants self-driving cars", AI, smartphones, cashless payments), stated as a slogan or bold claim rather than a specific argument? Answer no for specific, substantive arguments, news, or personal anecdotes without a provocative generalization.

stance.text: A reply-quote: the author wrote the first part, quoting the post after [Quoted post]. Does the author side with the quoted post, wanting readers to agree with it? Answer no if the author is mocking it, arguing against it, correcting it, warning people about it, or commenting on something else.
